items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-02-07
items.q: Then on my mother's side again, I got Si East, Frazier.

ctx.x: No, he didn't play any instrument at all. My daddy didn't. But part of my family played on my mother's side. All of them, John, Moreland, Eddie. They were all related to you, weren't they? Yeah. That's all cousins. All cousins? Yeah, that's on my mother's side. Then on my mother's side again, I got Si East, Frazier. Uh-huh. And his brother, Susan Lump, Frazier.
Which one? That's Simon? That's Simon.
